meta.name: consciousness-council
meta.description: Run a multi-perspective Mind Council deliberation on any question, decision, or creative challenge. Use this skill whenever the user wants diverse viewpoints, needs help making a tough decision, asks for a council/panel/board discussion, wants to explore a problem from multiple angles, requests devil's advocate analysis, or says things like "what would different experts think about this", "help me think through this from all sides", "council mode", "mind council", or "deliberate on this". Also trigger when the user faces a dilemma, trade-off, or complex choice with no obvious answer.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从多角度探讨任何问题，做出更明智的决策
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常面临复杂问题需要多方观点
copy.tagline_en: Deliberate any question from multiple perspectives for better decisions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often face complex decisions and want diverse viewpoints

howto.what: 面对一个决策或难题时,Claude 会挑选 4~6 个思维原型(如建筑师、反调者、未来学家),各自给出立场、推理与洞察,最后输出一份包含分歧点、核心张力、盲区与建议路径的综合结论。
howto.when: 当你想要多元观点、需要帮助做艰难决定,或说 “council mode”“mind council” 等词时触发;遇到两难、权衡或没有明显答案的复杂选择时也会用。

say.text: 用 council mode 帮我决定要不要换工作
say.note: 召集 4~6 个原型辩论,再给综合结论

say.text: 快速议事:我该先做哪个项目?
say.note: 改用 3 个原型、较短回复的快速模式

say.text: 深议这个定价策略,并加入反调者
say.note: 用 6 个原型,并指定包含某个原型

howto.what_en: For a decision or hard question, Claude summons 4–6 thinking archetypes that each give a position, reasoning and an insight, then outputs a synthesis naming the core tension, the blind spot and a recommended path.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want diverse viewpoints, need help with a tough decision, or say "council mode" or "mind council"; also for dilemmas, trade-offs or complex choices with no obvious answer.

say_en.text: Run council mode on whether I should change jobs
Quick council: which project should I do first?
Deep council on this pricing strategy, add the Contrarian
